answers.Molokai: Client-provided (build brief, 28 Oct 2026): molokhia is made only in Egypt. The Egyptian exporting entity is Bertaya Food Industries; whether Bertaya also manufactures it is not stated.

requirements.title: Register as a Prospect Vendor in Kroger Supplier Hub
requirements.detail: New vendors register as a Prospect Vendor, then complete the profile through Partner Pass; the profile becomes a Vendor profile only after business is awarded.

requirements.detail: Required for vendors supplying products under a Kroger brand label (private label).

requirements.title: FDA food facility registration (renewed every other year)
requirements.detail: Facilities that manufacture, process, pack or hold food for consumption in the United States must register with FDA.

requirements.title: A US importer with an FSVP for each food
requirements.detail: The FSVP importer (the US owner or consignee) must develop, maintain and follow a Foreign Supplier Verification Program for each food imported.
